periods.time: vol-11 ch-003 end of the award ceremony

name.zh: 加加美闯入拍下并立之人
name.en: Kagami interrupts to photograph the pair standing together

periods.summary: Just as Kaieda is about to close the festival, many identical Kagami duplicates rush the stage. The real Kagami reaches the podium and tells Stella to stand beside Ikki instead of remaining on the runner-up step. Stella jumps to Ikki's top step, Ikki supports her, and Kagami photographs the two lovers and rivals standing together as the crowd accepts that this is how they should be remembered.
periods.cause: Kagami wants the final image of the festival to reflect Ikki and Stella's true relationship rather than only the official win/loss record.
periods.outcome: The volume closes on Ikki and Stella as people who will proceed side by side despite the final's result.
periods.significance: Gives visual form to the title 'people standing side by side' and the central promise of the volume.
